name: resumepilot-mcp
description: Universal Job Application assistant: parse one master resume, build a reusable profile, score jobs (ATS/match), generate tailored resumes that never invent information, track applications, and produce a PDF report.
long_description: ResumePilot turns your ONE master resume into a full job-application workflow inside Claude Desktop. It parses your resume, asks only for missing profile info, analyzes any job description against it, computes original vs optimized ATS scores, generates a job-specific tailored resume (PDF + DOCX) using ONLY information genuinely present in your material, tracks every application in a local SQLite database, and generates a final PDF report with per-application tracking pages. It never stores passwords or OTPs, never bypasses CAPTCHA/2FA, and never invents skills, experience, education or certifications.

data_dir.title: Data folder
data_dir.description: Private folder where your resume, profile, application versions, tracking database and reports are stored. Keep it somewhere only you can access.

ats_target_score.title: Target ATS score
ats_target_score.description: The ATS score the optimizer aims for (never guaranteed, never keyword-stuffed).

match_score_threshold.title: Apply threshold
match_score_threshold.description: Minimum overall match score for a job to be recommended for applying.

log_level.title: Log level
log_level.description: error, warn, info, or debug (logs go to Claude's MCP logs only).

tools.name: analyze_master_resume
tools.description: Parse it, seed the profile, list missing info.

tools.name: setup_user_profile
tools.description: Apply answers to the missing-info questionnaire.

tools.name: analyze_job
tools.description: Analyze a job description; compute original ATS/match; create a tracked application.

tools.name: rank_jobs
tools.description: Rank analyzed applications by match score.

tools.name: optimize_resume_for_job
tools.description: Generate the tailored resume; original vs optimized ATS.

tools.name: apply_to_job
tools.description: Submit where supported; else pause; record APPLIED on confirmation.

tools.name: get_application_status
tools.description: Status/scores/timeline for one or all applications.

tools.name: search_application_emails
tools.description: Find + classify recruiter emails; update status.

tools.name: generate_application_report
tools.description: Final PDF report + HTML tracking pages.
